meta.name: RPSGT Scoring Lab authority and visual-validation map
meta.purpose: Keep every learner-facing Scoring Lab decision anchored to the current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 while using atlases only to validate physiologic appearance and teaching context.
authorityOrder: AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 and incorporated corrections
Current AASM FAQ only when Version 3 requires clarification
Sleep Pathways Guild original teaching schematic
AASM ISR interface behavior only when the learning objective is explicitly interface practice
meta.copyrightBoundary: Do not copy AASM figures, proprietary rule text, atlas tracings, tables, or review questions. Use original summaries and original Sleep Pathways Guild schematics.
meta.learnerReferenceStyle: Show APA-style references only; do not expose internal mapping labels or authority-map identifiers.

aasmV3.citation: Troester, M. M., Quan, S. F., Berry, R. B., et al., for the American Academy of Sleep Medicine. (2023). The AASM manual for the scoring of sleep and associated events: Rules, terminology and technical specifications (Version 3). American Academy of Sleep Medicine.

clinicalAtlas2018.role: visual and physiologic corroboration; never overrides current AASM rules
clinicalAtlas2018.citation: Gupta, R., Pandi-Perumal, S. R., & BaHammam, A. S. (2018). Clinical atlas of polysomnography. Apple Academic Press.
highValueChapters: Chapter 13: Scoring of Data in Adults

geyerAtlas2010.role: visual and physiologic corroboration; never overrides current AASM rules
geyerAtlas2010.citation: Geyer, J. D., Carney, P. R., & Payne, T. A. (2010). Atlas of polysomnography (2nd ed.). Lippincott Williams & Wilkins.

governingSections: IV. Sleep Staging Rules, Part 1: Rules for Adults
components.auditRule: Every schematic stage must visibly support the Version 3 criteria claimed in its rationale.

governingSections: IV. Sleep Staging Rules, Part 1: Rules for Adults
components.auditRule: Neighboring epochs provide context but do not replace Version 3 rules for assigning the current epoch.

governingSections: VIII. Respiratory Rules, Part 1: Rules for Adults, event-duration principles
components.auditRule: An epoch divider must never be taught as a physiologic event boundary. Candidate reductions used only for placement practice must not be presented as fully classified apnea/hypopnea events unless the required Version 3 criteria are supplied.
Each context stop tests a scoring rule or physiologic relationship, not trivia about an external scoring interface.

governingSections: VIII. Respiratory Rules, Part 1: Rules for Adults
V. Arousal Rules when RERA/arousal evidence is used
components.auditRule: Sensor choice, duration, amplitude reduction, effort pattern, desaturation/arousal requirement, and obstructive/central distinctions must agree with Version 3.

governingSections: III. Technical and Digital Specifications where signal validity is relevant
components.auditRule: Use Version 3 for the scoring decision and atlas material only to make the original schematic look physiologically believable.

governingSections: III-VIII as applicable to each item
visualValidation: Atlas/textbook support only when the item depends on waveform appearance
components.auditRule: Any rule-sensitive checkpoint item must trace to current official authority; older references may support background but cannot override Version 3.
